title: fix(plugin-audit): @mention notifications reach only mentioned users who can read the record
body:
Fixes #24785
Clause-②: no — the change narrows who a notification reaches; it is a runtime security-boundary change, so it sits on the human floor and its PR stays draft until the maintainer approves

## Summary

@mention notification recipients are now filtered by read access to the comment's record. A `collab.mention` notification carries the comment's preview and a deep link to the record, so it now reaches only a mentioned user who can read that record. The author is never notified.

- **New `mention-recipient-gate.ts` (plugin-audit).** Each `mentions` entry resolves to a user id. An email-shaped entry is looked up to its user; an audience expansion (`role:` / `team:` / `owner_of:`) is not a mention. Each user is then judged in their own envelope with no new ACL code. The envelope comes from `resolveUserAuthzGrants`, the resolver every request uses. The organization claim is vetted by `vetOrganizationClaim` under the posture in force (`effectiveTenancyPosture` over the `tenancy` service). The read is asked of `resolveReadableParentIds`, the evaluator every parent-derived read gate uses. So the tenant wall, sharing, RLS and object CRUD decide, the same way they decide when the user opens the deep link.
- **Withheld recipients** get no notification. One `warn` line records the user id (when there is one), the reason and the comment id. It never logs the comment text.
- **Fail closed.** A thread naming no record, a missing record, or a grant-resolution failure withholds the notification. `installAuditWriters` takes the gate as a new `admitMentionRecipients` option, and `AuditPlugin` wires the real one. A host calling `installAuditWriters` without it emits no mention notifications and is told once at `warn`.
- **`service-messaging` is untouched.** Its `RecipientResolver` serves every topic (approvals, notify nodes and so on), so the narrowing stays on the mention path. The writer hands messaging only already-admitted user ids.
- The fix lives at the producer, not as a row filter on `sys_notification`. A recipient reads their own notification, so no inbox-side read rule could tell a leaked copy from a legitimate one.

## Tests

All on head `2a048ca9` unless noted (the last commit is a comment-only edit to the gate's header; the test runs below are on `43bbd4e4`, byte-identical code).

- `src/mention-recipient-gate.integration.test.ts` (new, 10 cases). It runs a real kernel with ObjectQL, a real SQLite driver, `AuditPlugin`, the platform's `sys_user` / `sys_member` definitions and the real core resolver. Comments are inserted through the engine as their author, so the comment write gates and the `afterInsert` writer run. plugin-security's read layer is played by one middleware that composes the posture's tenant clause and an owner-only rule into the read's WHERE. Messaging is played by an `emit()` recorder.
  - `isolated`: a user of another organization gets nothing, in either spelling a mention takes. A fellow member who can read the record is notified, with `source` set to the record (the deep link) and the record's organization. An email of a member resolves to their id. The author gets nothing (by id or email). Audience expansions are no mention.
  - `group`: a non-member of the record's organization gets nothing; a member is notified.
  - `single`: a same-organization member that the record's own sharing excludes gets nothing; the same member is notified on a record they can read.
  - The withheld log line carries `{ reason, userId?, commentId }` only.
- `audit-writers.test.ts` (+3). With no gate composed, the writer emits no mention. With a gate that throws, it emits none. With a gate, it emits only the admitted ids, and the gate receives the expected input. The existing mention unit tests now pass a pass-through gate.
- `audit-hook-object-scope.test.ts`: the registration-scope pin passes a pass-through gate.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1` → `Test Files 60 passed (60) · Tests 976 passed (976)`, exit 0. The new test file was re-run after its final typing edit: `Tests 10 passed (10)`, typecheck exit 0.

### Ablations (committed fix, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored byte-identical, `git status` clean)

1. Organization-claim vetting removed (`const tenantId = claimedOrganization`): 4 of the 10 cases go red (the `isolated` cross-organization pins and the log pin). Restored blob `cd95ead9997d` == HEAD.
2. Writer bypasses the gate (`userIds = mentioned`): 8 of 10 go red. Restored blob `e0ccbab62207` == HEAD.

### End-to-end on a walled boot

This used a scratch copy of `examples/app-showcase` on `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated` with the organizations package, the real plugin-security and the real messaging inbox. One comment's mentions covered a user outside the record's organization, a fellow member, and the author.

- With this fix (full build at `43bbd4e4`): the outside user's inbox was unchanged (`unreadCount` 0 → 0). The fellow member got one `collab.mention` with `actionUrl` set to the record's page (`unreadCount` 0 → 1) and could read the record (200). The author got nothing.
- Control leg with the gate bypassed (ablation 2, rebuilt into `dist/`, marker proven present, then restored and rebuilt with the marker proven absent): the outside-user assertion fails. That shows the probe discriminates.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 70 families; reconciliation: `70 derived, 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. All exited 0, with the notes below:

- `pnpm check:dts-closure` and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first ran while the full build was still in progress (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`). Both were re-run after the build: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:query-options-erasure` went red on the first pass: 3 new untyped option sites in the new test. Those were typed, and the re-run gave exit 0 (`test surface: 236 site(s)`, at the ceiling).
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3: this shallow clone cannot reach its pinned positive-control commit. NOT MEASURED here; CI runs it.
- `cross-package-test-inputs`, `test-source-alias` and `nul-bytes` were re-run on the final code: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Same-organization member without read access.** Such a member no longer receives the preview: the rule is "can read the record", applied in every posture.
- **Cross-organization platform operators.** No special case is made. A mentioned operator is notified exactly when they can read the record in their own envelope.
- **`role:` / `team:` / `owner_of:` entries in `mentions`.** These no longer fan out. The field is documented as "JSON array of the user ids @mentioned".
- **Not in this PR's surface.** A dogfood case driving this over HTTP with the real plugin-security belongs to `packages/qa/dogfood`, which is outside this card's file surface. The walled-boot run above is the manual equivalent.
